mandatoryGates.raw-staging-type-rejection: Raw Main cannot inhabit cached command; positive wrapped Main stages through actual generic Tx API
mandatoryGates.raw-ledger-type-rejection: Raw Ledger cannot replace cached Ledger without trusted full-owner refresh
mandatoryGates.foreign-same-ID: Lookup/write/command ingress MissingEntity; receiver queue and payloads unchanged
mandatoryGates.optional-Main: MainNone retains missing behavior; no fabricated owner/view
mandatoryGates.optional-Ledger-rollback: Actual Main write occurs before absent Ledger; inverse and mark restore at original failed Tx boundary
mandatoryGates.prior-commit-survives: Earlier complete commit persists after later failure; failed command/ping publication removed
mandatoryGates.full-field-coherence: All four Main/Aux/Ledger fields plus frame/reserve/class/epoch and metadata match fresh TS
mandatoryGates.scalar-write-refresh: Repeated actual callback writes update cache and raw owner each tick
mandatoryGates.undo-refresh: Actual inverse scalar restoration refreshes cached view
mandatoryGates.spawn-insert-refresh: Actual deferred Spawn/InsertMain barrier yields fresh wrapped payload
mandatoryGates.membership-invalidation: Despawn/RemoveMain/InsertMain/Flag toggle/hole/growth alter actual ordered query
mandatoryGates.providers-and-captures: Actual Host/dispatcher call sites preserve abstract Owner/Aux, tokens and both capture styles

acceptance: All actual invoked source gates required; no inherited prototype PASS
